episodes.name: Since That Day
episodes.overview: A recap of events since the Fall of Shiganshina and the Battle of Trost.

episodes.name: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 1 / Day 2
episodes.overview: Eren has trouble getting to school on time, before he and Armin find themselves in the nurse's office.

episodes.name: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 3 / Day 4
episodes.overview: Eren tries to make a strong impression before his instructor, whilst Jean becomes jealous of Eren's closeness with Mikasa.

episodes.name: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 5 / Day 6 / Day 7
episodes.overview: Sasha is accused of crime she din't commit, whilst Armin finds a rather dubious book.  Later, Eren and Mikasa try to learn about the Titan's weakness.

episodes.name: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 8 / Day 9 / Day 10
episodes.overview: Eren accidentally stumbles into the classroom as the girls were taking off their clothes, Mikasa competes against Ymir for Eren's pudding, Krista and Ymir discuss who they should spend the day with.

episodes.name: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 11 / Day 12 / Day 13
episodes.overview: Eren attempts to improve his body by following Reiner's every move, Bertholdt tries to improve his confidence, Mikasa and Annie compete to see who can inflict more pain on Eren.

episodes.name: Ilse's Notebook: Memoirs of a Recon Corps Member
episodes.overview: Hange is insistent on capturing a Titan for the advancement of scientific research, but Erwin is adamant in his refusal to allow it. Will an unexpected discovery during an expedition beyond the walls alter the situation?

episodes.name: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 14 / Day 15 / Day 16
episodes.overview: Conny and Sasha attempt to prank Shadis, Eren decides to shave his hair, Armin tutors Eren, Sasha, and Conny when they failed their test.

episodes.name: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 17 / Day 18 / Day 19
episodes.overview: Eren struggles to balance himself on the omni-directional mobility gear, Jean gets lost during training, Marco sneaks into the Girl's Dormitory to return a lost pink bag.

episodes.name: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 20 / Day 21 / Day 22
episodes.overview: Franz and Hannah try to help Eren reconcile with Mikasa after an argument, Mikasa tries to act on her feelings with Eren, and Hange tries to communicate with a Titan.

episodes.name: Reading & Live Event
episodes.overview: A live reading event by seiyuu of Attack on Titan.

episodes.name: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 23 / Day 24 / Day 25
episodes.overview: Erwin tries to change his appearance to appeal to cadets, Levi analyzes himself from another's point of view, and the graduation ceremony of the 104th Cadet Corps takes place.

episodes.name: The Sudden Visitor: The Torturous Curse of Youth
episodes.overview: Two years after escaping the torment of his mother, Jean attempts to avoid her when returning to Trost for a training exercise. In a strange turn of events, he ends up in a cooking contest against Sasha.

episodes.name: Distress
episodes.overview: What begins as a simple training exercise turns into a disaster. A dysfunctional team of cadets must learn to work together after Christa is taken hostage by a group of brigands.

episodes.name: A Choice with No Regrets (1)
episodes.overview: Levi and his crew steal from merchants to scrape by in the dreary Underground. They're approached by a man from the surface with a job that could change their lives for the better.

episodes.name: A Choice with No Regrets (2)
episodes.overview: Levi's group joins the Scout Regiment, but they bring with them a hidden agenda. The upcoming expedition beyond the walls seems like the perfect opportunity to carry out their plan.

episodes.name: Lost Girls: Wall Sina, Goodbye (1)
episodes.overview: When Annie needs a day off from patrol duty to take care of some personal business, her roommate agrees to cover for her. But only if she does her the favor of searching for a girl who's been reported missing.

episodes.name: Lost Girls: Wall Sina, Goodbye (2)
episodes.overview: After discovering the body of Carly's lover, Annie plans the next steps of her search. However, her snooping lands her in trouble and she'll need to think quickly if she hopes to survive.

episodes.name: Lost Girls: Lost in the Cruel World
episodes.overview: Mikasa reflects on when she was lost in a world of her own making. Inside this world, everything went her way except for the one thing she wanted to change most.

episodes.name: The Final Chapters Special (1)
episodes.overview: As the rumbling advances, the remaining members of the Scout Regiment race against the clock with their Marleyan and Azumabito allies to catch up to Eren and stop the rumbling before the rest of the world is crushed under the Wall Titans' feet.

episodes.name: The Final Chapters Special (2)
episodes.overview: Eren, as the Founding Titan, advances on Fort Salta with countless other Titans. Appearing before the refugees, who stand on the brink of despair, are Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Conny, Reiner, Pieck, and Levi, who narrowly escaped from the rumbling. The battle between former comrades and childhood friends with Eren concludes here.

name: Specials
overview: The complete selection of specials relating to any 'Attack on Titan' TV series, including spin-offs and 'The Final Chapters' specials that aired.
